evidence.title: 10-Year Treasury Inflation-Indexed Security, Constant Maturity
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was -0.13 percentage points; it resolved to 'below recent range'.

evidence.title: August 2024 Market Recap - Pittenger & Anderson, Inc.
evidence.summary: Directly states that Treasury yields continued to decline in August, with the 10-year yield down 0.18%, and that falling rates boost fixed income returns.

evidence.title: U.S. August CPI Good but Not Great
evidence.summary: Reports that the August CPI report showed continued progress toward the Fed's inflation goals, with annual inflation falling to 2.5% from 2.9% in July. Also notes that Treasury bond yields saw a lift on the news, with the 10-Yr yield up 4 bps, indicating a potential counter-movement.

evidence.title: U.S. annual inflation in August fell to 2.5%, lowest since February 2021 | Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities
evidence.summary: Highlights that U.S. annual inflation continued its downward trend in August, falling to 2.5%, the lowest in 3 1/2 years. This disinflationary trend supports the idea of falling real yields.

evidence.title: US inflation trending lower, but some stickiness remains
evidence.summary: States that US consumer prices rose moderately in August and that financial markets boosted the chances of a quarter-point rate cut next week, which would put downward pressure on yields.

evidence.title: Here's the inflation breakdown for August 2024 — in one chart
evidence.summary: Mentions that the U.S. Federal Reserve is expected to start cutting interest rates this month, shifting focus from tackling inflation to averting recession, which would lead to lower yields.

evidence.title: United States: Inflation Drops below 3% - Desjardins
evidence.summary: Confirms that inflation continues to slow in the United States, with encouraging price movements in the past three months, keeping the door open for the Federal Reserve to start cutting rates at its September meeting.

evidence.title: Slower Faster
evidence.summary: Anticipates a moderate 0.2% increase in consumer prices for August, leading to CPI prices around 2.5% year-over-year, and PCE inflation of 2.3%. This suggests inflation may temporarily hit or go under the Fed’s 2.0% target, supporting rate cuts.

evidence.title: The Fed Has Room to Cut, Rates Are High Relative to Inflation, and Job Growth Could Use some Juicing Up | Wolf Street
evidence.summary: Argues that the Fed's policy rates are high and well above inflation rates, putting them in restrictive territory. This creates room for rate cuts to support the labor market, which would lower yields.
